name: HR 2. Team Structure & Performance Overview
rawText:
# Do you really know how your teams are structured and performing?
# 
#  - Which team leads oversee the largest teams?
#  - How many members does each team have?
#  - How many unique locations does each team cover?
#  - What is the average salary within each team?
#  - What is the total payroll cost of each team?
#  - What are the lowest and highest salaries within each team?
#  - What is the average performance rating across each team?
#  - How many performance reviews have been recorded for each team?
# 
# What if you could combine organizational relationships, team structures, salary information, and historical performance reviews into a single readable query — including self-referencing relationships and nested aggregations?
# No complex SQL. No manually written joins. No separate queries for each calculation.
# Just describe what you want to know. Let OQuery handle the complexity.
# ____________________________________________________________

Employees:
    FirstName + < > + LastName TeamLead
    Members.Count(Id) TotalMembers
    Members.Count(LocationId) TotalLocations
    Members.Avg(Salary) AverageTeamSalary
    Members.Sum(Salary) TeamPayroll
    Members.Min(Salary) LowestSalary
    Members.Max(Salary) HighestSalary
    Members.PerformanceReviews.Avg(Rating) AverageTeamRating
    Members.Count(PerformanceReviews.Id) TotalReviews
Order TotalMembers DESC
id: HR 2. Manager span and team profile
